player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Player {player_id} i roto i te whutupaoro o HighSociety (whutupaoro 2-player).
Wāhanga whutupaoro:  Ko ngā kaari prestīhi 10 e rīpoata ana kotahi i muri i te kotahi.
Pīra:    I ia rīpoata, whiriwhiri pūtea motu kaari 1-11 i te pō, whakaatu.
            • Ko te pīra teitei e wini te kaari prestīhi, ka whakakorea i tera kaari pūtea.
            • Ko te pīra raro e pupuri i tōna kaari pūtea.
            • Tie - > ka whakaputahia ngā pīra e rua, ka rīpoata anō te kaari prestīhi kotahi.
Scoring:    I muri i ngā rīpoata katoa 10, tapiri **te moni toa + ngā pūtea prestīhi**.
            Ko te *net-worth* teitei e wini (tīe tino pūmau -> hopu).

**Action syntax**  →  pīra i te kaari kotahi pērā i '[7]' rānei '[11]'.

board.money_cards: Ko ō kāri moni e toe ana: {money}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Me whakauru tonu ki te kāri moni kotahi [X].
invalid_move.card_not_held: Kāore i a koe te kāri moni.

message.tie: Tīhanga - ngā tāpae kua whakahokia. Tāpae anō!
message.auction_result: I tāpae P0 {bid0}, i tāpae P1 {bid1}. Ka toa te Kaiwhakataetae {winner} i te mana {prize} (katoa {total}).

outcome.draw: Ko te rua o nga uara-taonga {nw0}  he rite tonu.
